scope: offline only; no COM, no RF, no flash, no HEX, no cryptography, no keys

parser_rules.explicit_context: every per-context command must carry ctx; a missing ctx is refused, never defaulted
parser_rules.session_records_reject_ctx: INFO, STATS, STATUS and END refuse a ctx field outright
parser_rules.duplicate_field: a repeated key is refused, because last-one-wins would let a second ctx silently override the first
parser_rules.unknown_field: refused rather than ignored, so a host typo cannot silently change a line's meaning
parser_rules.ascii_only: bytes outside 0x20..0x7e are refused before anything is interpreted
parser_rules.hex_case: lowercase hex only, so one byte sequence has one spelling
config_invariants: two enabled entries may not share the same paired tuple
bind_invariants: RAW identity differs from trust centre identity
poll policy bounds carried over from V25 key_gate
tx_invariants: at least nine MAC bytes so PAN and both shorts are present

formatting_rules.whole_lines_only: a record is written completely or not at all; a truncated record is never emitted
formatting_rules.foreign_frames: a frame outside both contexts is tagged ctx=none, never 0 or 1
formatting_rules.rx_timestamps: four separate stamps with validity flags: rx_end, ack_address, ack_start, ack_end
formatting_rules.not_in_interrupt: formatting never runs in the RADIO interrupt

groups: envelope: prefix, unknown command, missing id, field syntax, duplicate field, non ASCII
context field: missing, out of range, and refused on session records
CONFIG validation including identical tuple refusal and same short under different PAN acceptance
BIND validation including identity collision, extPAN mismatch and poll policy bounds
TX validation including class names, odd hex and uppercase hex refusal
formatting of RX, TXACCEPT, TXDONE, STATS and ERROR, including the small buffer refusal
result, match and reason token names

fuzz_dual_records.method: one to three byte mutations or truncations of five valid seed commands
fuzz_dual_records.sanitizers: address and undefined enabled during the whole run
checked_on_acceptance: CONFIG: generation non zero, at least one context enabled, no identical tuple, channel 21
BIND: ctx present and in range, RAW differs from TC, extPAN equals TC, coordinator short zero
TX: ctx present and in range, MAC length within bounds
ACK and SCAN: ctx present and in range
INFO, STATS, STATUS, END: no ctx

not_proven: that any firmware emits these records; main.c still speaks RADIOV9 and carries no ctx on RX
any real radio or host behaviour
